description: Defines the Edge class for directed graph edges in Spark GraphX, including methods for vertex relations and ordering.

classes.name: Edge
classes.description: Represents a directed edge with source and destination vertices and an attribute.

methods.name: otherVertexId
methods.description: Returns the vertex ID on the other end of the edge given one vertex ID.

methods.name: relativeDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the edge relative to a given vertex ID.
